production.note: US model years. First: BMW NA says the cars "will begin sales as 2015 models in early Summer, 2014". Last: BMW NA's final technical data sheet for this car is for the 2018 model (bmw-us-2018-m3-techdata), and AutoTrader.ca's used review covers the '2015-2018 BMW M3' (autotrader-ca-m3-2015-2018). No opened BMW page says in so many words that 2018 was the last model year.

body.note: 'No of Doors / Seats' 4 / 5. The two-door cars are the separate M4.

aspiration.note: 'M TwinPower Turbo technology comprises two fast-responding mono-scroll turbochargers'

transmission.note: 'standard six-speed manual gearbox'; 'optional 7-speed M Double Clutch Transmission with Drivelogic' (M DCT).

powerHp.note: Quote: "Engine power / at rpm bHP / 1/min 425 / 5500-7300 425 / 5500-7300". Also bmw-us-2013-m3-m4-release: "With 425 horsepower from 5,500 – 7,300 rpm". The optional Competition Package (a package, not a separate model) is rated 444 hp at 7,000 rpm per BMW NA's 2018 M3 Competition technical data (bmw-us-2018-m3-competition-techdata).

weightLb.note: Sedan with the 6-speed manual, 2015 model. Quote: "Curb weight (US) Kg / lbs 1631 / 3595 1606 / 3540" (first column M DCT, second column manual). BMW NA's 2018 sheet gives 3,575 lb manual and 3,630 lb DCT (bmw-us-2018-m3-techdata).
